verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1683). Walks every non-test source file under app/(main)/network/contacts, app/(main)/connections, app/(capture) and components/connections, plus the Network hub tabs and the capture form and shell (42 files; fewer than 25 means the wrong tree), strips comments, and fails on an em dash, a member-facing steward, Space CRM, harvest, a contact called a profile (New profile, No profiles yet, Save profile, a Profiles back link), Title Case QR Scan, or a Community tab; then requires the hub tabs to read Members and My Contacts as their lib/nav-areas.ts rows do, /network/contacts to say My Contacts, Add a contact and No contacts yet, the Space prompt to name Community Resonance, both back links to say My Contacts, and /network to fall back to the title Members. Fails on main (451c500f0) at the harvest arm. Exits 1 naming the file when a wired file is gone.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1683). PREMISE HELD at 451c500f0 (main): member copy on these screens said steward (the Network visibility option, its helper, the shared-contact page), Space CRM (the prompt on My Contacts; the canon name is Community Resonance), harvest (the empty state and the scanner), called a contact a profile (New profile twice, No profiles yet, Save profile, a Profiles back link on two pages returning to a page titled My Contacts), had a Title Case QR Scan tab, and labelled the Members directory tab Community. No member string carried an em dash. WHAT CHANGED (copy only). /network/contacts: Add a contact, No contacts yet, a plain empty state, QR scan, In Frequency contacts, the Network hub tabs Members, Friends, My Contacts (and /network falls back to the title Members). /connections/new: title Add a contact, Save contact, local Hosts on the Network option, plain scanner and Vera copy, back link My Contacts. /connections/[id]: back link My Contacts, your copy not your own note, a Crew tease without pipeline, Add to Frequency contacts. /connections/shared/[id] and the Sharing control: Hosts, not stewards. The Space prompt names Community Resonance and See Spaces. The capture doors were already in voice and are unchanged. Help: save-by-scanning names the QR scan tab, find-people the Members directory. No migration.
